item.title: EX-GER COULD SCUPPER CELTIC MOVE FOR £35m MAN

item.title: CELTIC: INS AND OUTS
item.description: CELTIC have agreed a £435,000 loan fee for striker Junior Adamu from Bundesliga outfit SC Freiburg. There is also a £4.3million option to make the transfer permanent, according to Sky Sports. The 24-year-old Austrian international frontman was the first to arrive on a hectic deadline day for the champions as they reinforced Martin O’Neill’s first-team squad. Capped [...]

item.title: TOBI OR NOT TOBI? KEEPER FINALLY QUITS CELTIC
item.description: TOBI OLUWAYEMI has finally quit Celtic on a permanent deadline-day deal to sign for Leyton Orient. The London-born keeper, so highly rated by ex-boss Ange Postecoglou, has been out on loan to Cork City, Wacker Innsbruck, Dunfermline and Kilmarnock in recent seasons.
